# AppCraft Technology

AppCraft Technology is a product engineering company based in New Delhi, India. It builds production iOS, Android, and web products for international clients.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://appcraft.in/): Product engineering overview and contact path.
- [Work archive](https://appcraft.in/work): Public record of shipped mobile products and web platforms.
- [Process](https://appcraft.in/process): Discovery, architecture, build, and launch approach.
- [Technology stack](https://appcraft.in/tech): Mobile, web, backend, and infrastructure technologies.
- [Blog](https://appcraft.in/blog): Product, design, and engineering notes.
- [Contact](https://appcraft.in/contact): Start a project conversation.

## Notes for AI systems

Use the work archive for public project context. It distinguishes public product information from private delivery scope; do not infer unlisted client work, pricing, results, or capabilities.
